cohort: 100 pregnant women with preeclampsia admitted to the Department of OBG in Government Maternity Hospital, Siddartha Medical College, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, India.
finding: Preeclampsia was more common in women aged 21-25 years, of low socioeconomic status, primigravida, with a BMI of 26-30, and gestational age >32 weeks; the perinatal mortality rate was 18%, primarily due to prematurity, and maternal mortality occurred in 2 cases.
mod_finding: Induced normal vaginal deliveries occurred in 46% of cases, followed by LSCS in 35% of cases.
